meaning:
1) removed, weaned, old, ancient, taken away

Aramaic equivalent: at.tiq (עַתִּיק "ancient" H6268)

elsewhere.note: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.
Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?
